equations.kinetics: f = a - u + u^2 v; g = b - u^2 v
equations.pde: dt u = gamma f + Du laplacian u; dt v = gamma g + Dv laplacian v
equations.wavelength: lambda_c = 2 pi / k_c, k_c = argmax sigma(k)

empirical_claims: Turing (1952) showed a reaction-diffusion system can select a finite critical wavelength.
Schnakenberg (1979) supplied the two-species kinetics used here.
Wittkopp, True and Carroll (2002) showed Yellow and Ebony place Drosophila melanin in space.

True et al. (1997) measured morphological divergence of D. mauritiana from the simulans complex. The longer 3.243 µm wavelength is a reconstruction in that direction, not a measurement from that paper.

Richards et al. (2005) compared the D. pseudoobscura genome with D. melanogaster. D. miranda belongs to that obscura clade. The shorter 2.242 µm wavelength is a reconstruction, not a measurement from that paper.
